item.title: Acoustic Tuesday w/ Peter Townsend — Tue Sep 15, 5:00 PM — Village Pub Biltmore Village
item.description:
Peter Townsend is a road-tested guitarist, mandolin player, and solo musician blending Americana, bluegrass, and rock ’n’ roll into a dynamic, roots-driven sound. Originally from Wisconsin, he began his musical journey in Alaska in the late ’90s with The Photonz, a jam band known for its energetic mix of bluegrass and rock. Now performing with Laron Huntley & The Gravely Brothers, Peter brings a soulful, expressive style shaped by years on the road and a deep love of live music.

item.title: Ask About Our Featured Listings — Wed Sep 16 — LiveMusicAsheville.com
item.description:
Established in February 2019, LiveMusicAsheville.com now reaches thousands of people every week actively searching for live music in the Asheville area. Roughly 60% of our traffic comes from Google Search as we dominate the top of the results for queries such as “Asheville live music” & “live music Asheville”. Meanwhile our direct traffic is experiencing explosive growth, proving more locals are now using us as their go-to music calendar. Our free listings include just the basics of Who’s Playin’ Where & When. Our Featured Listings really stand out among the dozens of events on the calendar every day. While we update every Wednesday for the following Friday thru Thursday, these Featured Listings are published much sooner and include your picture or poster, a description of the event and the venue, website/ticket links and a Google map. We also share these events on our social media stories to help further promote your show.
Source: LiveMusicAsheville.com

item.title: Snowball Trail Out & Back 7.6 mile, 2,100 ft. FITNESS Hike — Wed Sep 16, 9:30 AM
item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group **This challenging** 7.6-mile **Level 7\*** Fitness hike begins at the intersection of the Blue Ridge Parkway and the entrance road to the Craggy Gardens Picnic Area, which is closed. We will walk up the closed road to the MST. This hike begins on the MST South and takes a right turn on the YELLOW-blazed Little Snowball Mountain trail. We climb 2 steep ridgelines (with an optional 3rd ridgeline on the outbound and 2 ridgelines on the return. The hike includes views from Hawksbill Rock, a popular destination viewpoint on this trail (pictured), and continues to the former fire tower location atop Little Snowball Mountain where we will break for a snack before returning. There are very few flat sections on this trail.
**PACE:** Our average pace is around 3 MPH, slowing on steeper grades and for rugged conditions, briefly regrouping as needed. There is a bolder rock scramble (Hawksbill Rock) on this trail. Please be capable of hiking this distance and elevation

The intention is to bring us together in a safe, energetic space to learn, share, and lift each other's vibration and access to wisdom, for the highest good of all.

item.title: The Morning Read — Mon Sep 28, 9:00 AM
item.description:
AVL Digital Nomads **The Morning Read: "Can I afford to … ?"**
...Hire? ....Buy the second van? ....Take the bigger space? ....Raise prices? ....Finally pay myself?
It's the most common question owners ask, and it almost never gets answered — because "afford" isn't a feeling and it isn't the bank balance. It's a number, and it isn't on your P&L.
This session is about learning how to find it. If you're a business owner trying to figure out whether you can afford your next move, or a financial professional with a few tricks up your sleeve for helping folks find the answer faster — come. We'll walk through the numbers that help with decisions. Not so you walk out with one answer — so the next time the question comes up, you know how to answer it yourself.
Real numbers from real books, read out loud — like reading tea leaves, except it's math. For owners, buyers, and the people who advise them. No accounting background required.

item.title: Shut Up & Write - South Asheville — Sun Oct 4, 10:00 AM
item.description:
Shut Up & Write!® Western North Carolina Coworking for writers in your area! Join us for some focused writing time. All writers and all experience levels are welcome and don’t worry, no one will see what you've written. This session is about getting your writing done and meeting other writers in your area.
Please arrive a few minutes early to say hello to everyone, grab a drink, and get your writing tools ready. Once everyone’s arrived, I will lead quick introductions and then set the timer for our quiet and focused writing session.
Afterward, we’ll have time to chat and get to know each other. We often talk about our successes and challenges as writers. If you don’t have time to stick around, no worries!
A note about the format We don’t host critiques or readings. These events are a safe space for writers of all skill levels and genres to work on their craft, so no one will read or critique your writing.
For our full event schedule, visit https://shutupwrite.com

item.title: FAUST with live metal score — Thu Oct 8, 8:00 PM — Eulogy
item.description:
Eulogy Presents: FAUST with live metal score Thurs, October 8th, 2026 Eulogy - 10 Buxton Ave. Asheville, NC 28801 Doors 7PM || Show 8PM **FAUST with live metal score** On October 8th, step into the dark world of F.W. Murnau’s Faust (1926), accompanied by a haunting live metal score performed by The Silent Light. Murnau’s legendary tale of temptation, damnation, and the supernatural is transformed into an overwhelming collision of silent cinema and crushing sound. One night only at Eulogy in Ashe
Source: Eulogy
